name: red-squiggle
description: Type-checks and lints the file Claude just edited and puts the errors in that same tool result

tsc.title: TypeScript
tsc.description: Run the project's local tsc (--noEmit, incremental) after TS/JS edits

eslint.title: ESLint
eslint.description: Run the project's local eslint on the edited file when an eslint config exists

ruff.title: Ruff
ruff.description: Run ruff check on edited Python files when ruff is installed

timeoutSeconds.title: Checker timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Each checker is abandoned after this long and the edit goes through unannotated
